class Mentor:
    def __init__(self, aName):
        self._name = aName
        self._students = []

    def setName(self, aName):
        self._name = aName
        return True

    def getName(self):
        return self._name

    def getStudent(self, index):
        return self._students[index]

    def getStudents(self):
        return tuple(self._students)

    def numberOfStudents(self):
        return len(self._students)

    def hasStudents(self):
        return len(self._students) > 0

    def indexOfStudent(self, aStudent):
        return next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._students) if x is aStudent), -1)

    def isNumberOfStudentsValid(self):
        return self.numberOfStudents() >= __class__.minimumNumberOfStudents()

    @staticmethod
    def minimumNumberOfStudents():
        return 3

    def addStudent(self, aStudent):
        if any(x is aStudent for x in self._students):
            return False
        self._students.append(aStudent)
        if aStudent.indexOfMentor(self) == -1 and not aStudent.addMentor(self):
            del self._students[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._students) if x is aStudent), -1)]
            return False
        return True

    def removeStudent(self, aStudent):
        oldIndex = next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._students) if x is aStudent), -1)
        if oldIndex == -1:
            return False
        if self.numberOfStudents() <= __class__.minimumNumberOfStudents():
            return False
        del self._students[oldIndex]
        if aStudent.indexOfMentor(self) != -1 and not aStudent.removeMentor(self):
            self._students.insert(oldIndex, aStudent)
            return False
        return True

    def setStudents(self, *newStudents):
        if len({id(x) for x in newStudents}) != len(newStudents) or len(newStudents) < __class__.minimumNumberOfStudents():
            return False
        oldStudents = {id(x): x for x in self._students}
        self._students.clear()
        for aNewStudent in newStudents:
            self._students.append(aNewStudent)
            if id(aNewStudent) in oldStudents:
                del oldStudents[id(aNewStudent)]
            else:
                aNewStudent.addMentor(self)
        for anOldStudent in oldStudents.values():
            anOldStudent.removeMentor(self)
        return True

    def addStudentAt(self, aStudent, index):
        if not self.addStudent(aStudent):
            return False
        if index < 0:
            index = 0
        if index > self.numberOfStudents():
            index = self.numberOfStudents() - 1
        del self._students[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._students) if x is aStudent), -1)]
        self._students.insert(index, aStudent)
        return True

    def addOrMoveStudentAt(self, aStudent, index):
        if not any(x is aStudent for x in self._students):
            return self.addStudentAt(aStudent, index)
        if index < 0:
            index = 0
        if index > self.numberOfStudents():
            index = self.numberOfStudents() - 1
        del self._students[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._students) if x is aStudent), -1)]
        self._students.insert(index, aStudent)
        return True

    def delete(self):
        from example.Student import Student
        copyOfStudents = tuple(self._students)
        self._students.clear()
        for aStudent in copyOfStudents:
            if aStudent.numberOfMentors() <= Student.minimumNumberOfMentors():
                aStudent.delete()
            else:
                aStudent.removeMentor(self)

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "name:" + str(self.getName())
                + "]")
